relations.rationale: The baton signal starting warmups is unrelated to whether the new piece's harmonies required run-throughs.
The room quieting for scales has no bearing on relative ages of Otto and Kai.
Scales rising and falling during warmup is unrelated to the difficulty of a later new piece's harmonies.
Scales during rehearsal are unrelated to Ana passing water during a break.
The room quieting for scales has no logical connection to Otto nodding in agreement.
Otto being older than Kai has no bearing on Hana humming by the window.
Otto's age relative to Kai has no connection to Hana flipping through her folder.
Otto being older than Kai is independent of Kai's age relative to Xavi.
Otto's age relative to Kai has no bearing on the rehearsal moving to a new piece.
Otto older than Kai does not directly determine whether Xavi is older than Otto.
Hana standing by the window humming is inconsistent with her simultaneously flipping through her folder elsewhere, suggesting these are different moments rather than supporting each other.
Hana humming near the window is unrelated to whether the new piece's harmonies required run-throughs.

Kai older than Xavi combined with Xavi older than Otto would create a contradiction if Otto is also older than Kai, but taken alone Kai>Xavi contradicts Xavi>Otto only if transitivity implies Kai>Otto conflicting with claim 12; alone these two just relate ages of Kai/Xavi and Xavi/Otto, which are consistent, not contradictory.
Kai being older than Xavi has no bearing on Ana passing water during break.
The rehearsal moving to a new piece supports the claim that the new piece had tricky harmonies needing run-throughs, as it sets up that scenario.
Moving to a new piece is unrelated to whether Kai's part had gotten easier since last rehearsal.
The new piece having tricky harmonies supports the idea that Xavi struggled at first to find his note.
Tricky harmonies requiring run-throughs before blending supports Xavi eventually locking in with the basses.
The difficulty of the new piece's harmonies has no bearing on Xavi's age relative to Otto.
The new piece requiring several run-throughs before blending supports the idea that Xavi still needed more practice.
